snippet.title: Kingdom Hearts Fragmented Keys by Go For Launch Productions and Studio EX
snippet.description:
This upload is meant for archival!! 

KH FANS YOU HAVE BEEN SERVED!!!!

I have been meaning to upload since for quite a long time but never gotten the time due to being unsure when it would be the right time to upload it. But I'm incredibly sorry it took forever to upload and no other videos and archives won't be like this on the channel ever again. 

(edit:14/2/25 since my dyslexic self misspelled a name by accident)
Context: KHO/Kingdom Hearts Fragmented Keys was a scrapped MMO mobile game that was developed by many studios like GoForLaunch, Trilabyrinth, Studio EX, Wide Load Games, and alongside. Goriotik and Breakiron.
